meta.note: Maps major Indian cities to the water board that serves them. hasTariffFile is true only where a real, schema-validated tariff JSON exists in src/data/water-tariffs/ — every other city still uses the honest self-rate-input calculator. Mirrors the discoms.json / gas-cgds.json pattern. IMPORTANT: unlike DISCOMs/CGDs, our /water/[slug] route is STATE-granularity (one page per state/UT), while water boards are CITY-granularity (a state can have multiple boards, e.g. Maharashtra has both BMC for Mumbai and PMC for Pune). Delhi happens to work cleanly today since it's both a single-city UT and an existing state slug. Boards below other than DJB are listed for future reference only — wiring them in will need a city-level routing layer, not just a hasTariffFile flip.
